sangs rgyas chos srung mthu bo che/ /nag po chen po tshogs kyi bdag/sku gsung thugs kyi mgon po dang*/ /phyogs bcu'i mgon po sde brgyad mgon/ /

tei:div.tei:p: sangs rgyas chos srung mthu bo che// nag po chen po tshogs kyi bdag /sku gsung thugs kyi mgon po dang*// phyogs bcu'i mgon po sde brgyad mgon// lha dmag bye ba'i tshogs dang bcas// 'dir gshegs bshams pa'i mchod pa bzhes// sha khrag gtor ma phud rgod kyis// tshogs bdag mgon po'i thugs dam bskang*// sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs// snga dgra dar ba rtsad nas chod// phyi dgra sems pa rdul du rlog /da dgra bsam pa phye mar thongs// las bcol phrin las 'grub par mdzod//

ces pa'ang bstan srung ngor mkhan ming pas bris pa dge legs 'phel/ / ༈ rdo rje dur khrod tshogs kyi bdag /ma hā ka la lcam dral dang*// sku gsung thugs mgon lha dmag tshogs// mchod gsol las bzhi'i phrin las sgrub// gnod sbyin drag po yang le ber// bdud rje drang dkar bka' 'khor bcas// 'dir gshegs mthun pa'i dam rdzas bzhes// sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs// thams cad ma lus rtsad nas chod// bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod// tshul khrims rin chen ngor pad+ma las 'brel rtsal gyis so// ༈ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/ 'jig rten srid pa'i dkyil 'khor nas// btsan rgod 'bar ba mthu bo che// khro 'bar mched bdun lcam dang bcas// btsan rigs sum brgya drug cu'i tshogs// rig 'dzin pad+ma'i bka' bzhin du// dam tshig dbang gis gnas 'dir gshegs// mthun rdzas sha khrag gtor ma dang*// bdud rtsi phud kyi mchod pa bzhes// bdag cag rnal 'byor 'khor bcas la// dge zhing zhi ba'i phrin las mdzod// ces pa'ang smar khams snar nas pad+ma las 'brel rtsal gyis spel ba dge'o// //
